turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Nadia. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm calling about my mother's account. She's in hospital and asked me to help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can only discuss an account with an authorised party. Is your name on it?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, but I have her details. Her name is Jordan Calloway, date of birth 0117-1993.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry — having her details doesn't make you authorised. I can't discuss the account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: She's in hospital. What am I supposed to do?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: We can send a power of attorney form to the address on file, or she can add you as an authorised user by phone when she's able.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That's not helpful, but I understand it's the rule.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll mail the form today so it's ready.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. Thank you for at least explaining it.

action_items: Mail power of attorney form to address on file
labels.notes: PII belongs to a third party. Must still be redacted; agent behaviour is correct.
